auth0provider.title: Auth0Provider
auth0provider.description: Provides the Auth0 context to your React application. Wrap your app root with this component.

use-auth0.title: useAuth0
use-auth0.description: Hook to access the Auth0 client and user state.

returns.description: Object containing user, isLoading, isAuthenticated, loginWithRedirect, logout, and getAccessTokenSilently.

use-login-with-redirect.title: loginWithRedirect
use-login-with-redirect.description: Redirects the user to the Auth0 Universal Login page.

examples.code:
const { loginWithRedirect } = useAuth0();

<button onClick={() => loginWithRedirect()}>Log in</button>

use-logout.title: logout
use-logout.description: Logs the user out and optionally redirects to the Auth0 logout endpoint.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Options including logoutParams.returnTo for post-logout redirect URL.

examples.code:
const { logout } = useAuth0();

<button onClick={() => logout({ logoutParams: { returnTo: window.location.origin } })}>
  Log out
</button>

with-auth-required.title: withAuthenticationRequired
with-auth-required.description: Higher-order component that wraps a React component and requires the user to be authenticated. Redirects to login if not.
